format.medium: Stylised 2D motion graphics and anime explainer

style: Dynamic motion graphics paired with high-contrast character art. Dark background palette with glowing red and green highlight accents. High-contrast, directional lighting emphasizes muscular silhouettes. Energetic jump-cuts, rapid zooms, and bold callout text.
never_change: The structured sequence of low-testosterone symptoms followed by five actionable natural protocols.

facts.detail: Modern men have significantly lower testosterone levels than previous generations.
Anabolic steroids and artificial boosters cause severe long-term side effects.
Testosterone levels can be restored naturally through specific lifestyle changes.
Erectile dysfunction and lack of morning erections are primary indicators of low T.
Penile erections require strong blood circulation through healthy blood vessels.
Low testosterone inhibits nitric oxide production, compromising vascular health.
Accelerated muscle loss and weak bone density indicate deficient T levels.
Excessive fat accumulation on the chest and abdomen signals low testosterone.
Adipose tissue produces aromatase, converting testosterone into estrogen.
Brain fog, chronic frustration, fear, and zero ambition are psychological signs of low T.
Quality sleep of 7 to 8 hours daily is essential for peak hormone production.
Blue light exposure before sleep suppresses melatonin and disrupts hormone synthesis.
Kegel exercises strengthen pelvic muscles and enhance regional blood circulation.
Heavy squats performed multiple times weekly trigger systemic testosterone release.
High-intensity training pushed to physical limits forces natural androgen spikes.
Sufficient intake of Zinc, Vitamin D, and Magnesium is required for hormone synthesis.
Traditional botanical herbs like Safed Musli and Akarkara safely support vitality.
